transcript: Solution engineer: Walk me through an inspection today.
Drone operations lead: We fly each site twice a year. A flight produces a few thousand thermal images. A contractor marks anomalies and sends a PDF report six weeks later.
O&M director: By the time we read it, half the anomalies have either fixed themselves or turned into failures.
Performance analyst: And the report does not tell us which ones cost us energy. A hot cell on a string that is already underperforming matters more than one on a healthy string.
Solution engineer: What do you want instead?
O&M director: A ranked list of anomalies within a couple of days of the flight, with the image and the string it sits on.
Performance analyst: Ranked by estimated energy impact, using the monitoring data we already have per string.
Solution engineer: Where does the monitoring data live?
Performance analyst: In our monitoring platform. It has an export, daily per string. No public API, but we can schedule a CSV drop.
Drone operations lead: The images come with GPS and gimbal angle. Mapping an image to a string is doable but nobody has done it for our layouts.
Solution engineer: Do you have site layouts in a usable form?
Drone operations lead: CAD drawings for most sites. Two of the older ones only have PDFs.
Asset owner representative: Our concern is false positives. Sending a truck to a healthy panel costs more than ignoring a warm one for a month.
O&M director: So the ranking has to be conservative and explain itself.
Solution engineer: What is your current false positive rate from the contractor reports?
O&M director: We have never measured it. Anecdotally, high.
Asset owner representative: We would want that measured before anyone trusts a new ranking.
Solution engineer: Who would act on the ranked list?
O&M director: The regional technicians, through the normal work order system. That part does not change.
Drone operations lead: The drone flights themselves stay with us. We are not outsourcing that.
Solution engineer: Which sites for a pilot?
O&M director: Two sites in the south region, both with CAD layouts and a flight due next month.
Solution engineer: Data constraints?
Asset owner representative: Images and production data are commercially sensitive. Contract terms say they stay in the region.
Performance analyst: We also talked about ground robots for cleaning. That is a different conversation.
O&M director: And eventually we want this for wind sites too. Not in this scope.

traps.note: The false positive rate has never been measured.
Image to string mapping has never been done for these layouts.
